caption: Torch tower N = 6 gt (track delay, family delay-torch: N = 6 + 4n gt, n = 0): a repeater powers a block, 2 torches climb from it (each torch powers the block above it, the next torch stands on that block): N = 2 + 2 x 2 gt, non-inverting with an even count
Comparator line N = 2 gt (track delay, family delay-cmp: N = 2 + 2n gt, n = 0): 1 compare-mode comparator(s) in a row on stones, 2 gt each; keeps pulses down to 2-3 gt

One repeater set to 1: the signal comes out 2 ticks later. Each repeater adds 2 ticks per notch of its setting, so any even delay is a line of them, 2 blocks (repeater + stone) per started 8 ticks (track delay, family delay-rep2: N = 2 + 8n gt, n = 0)
